newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Peter Lehmann buys Clare Valley vineyard.
newsitem.headline: Peter Lehmann buys Clare Valley vineyard.

text.p: South Australian wine producer Peter Lehmann Wines Ltd said on Wednesday it had bought a 20.2 hectare vineyard in the premium Clare Valley region for A$1 million, taking its total vineyard holdings to 56.6 hectares.
Lehmann said it remained firmly committed to its base in the Barossa Valley and to its independent growers, but the sourcing of suitable quality fruit remained a key issue for growth.

"To gain access to a greater quantity of premium fruit and help spread the agricultural risk somewhat, PLW has looked outside the Barossa which at present has few opportunities for vineyard acquisition," it said.
The company said it expected the first crop on the new property, planted with premium red varieties, to be harvested for the 1999 vintage with full production reached by 2001.
